about: (Noah, 2026-11-23) the full class voice set to record: 80 lines a class, read male and female (sum, des, alc, ssw). Same as the Class Voices doc. tag = Eleven v3 audio tag. When the mp3s arrive this replaces sheets/classvo.json's rows; triggers with wired=false need code.

triggers.when: The night countdown ends and the first wave rises
The last wave of a night falls (dawn)
A Dragon Priest or a boss night begins
One of the word dragons is first seen
An event night starts (fog, harpies, themed waves)
You free a city
You walk into a city you haven't freed yet
An easter egg step is done
Daytime, nothing happening for 90 s
Three or more of the dead fall within two seconds
Your health drops below a quarter
An elite or champion appears near you
You run out of magicka (the Alchemist: out of flasks)
You fall (bleed-out in co-op, or the killing blow solo)
You get back up (revived, Quick Revive, a second life)
Lay the Restless to Rest is taken up
The Stone's Whisper begins: the altar speaks its riddle
You find the place the riddle names
Repeat the Echo: the stones start to sing
Repeat the Echo: a wrong stone, or too slow
Repeat the Echo: the song answered
A Priest's Seal breaks (the first two)
The last seal breaks and the Dragon Priest comes out
A Dragon Priest falls
One of Alduin's word dragons is slain
A wonder is won
The Echo of Alduin appears on the Throat of the World
Every Echo Altar in Skyrim is awake
You upgrade an item of your kit at the altar
You take a perk (a brew) at the altar
You take a Dragon Priest's relic
You buy something new from the Armory

lines.text: The dead are waking. Good... so are mine.
Hush now. I can hear them clawing at the earth.
Another night. Come, spirits. Stand with me.
Rise, old friends. The restless need someone to show them the way.
Dawn. Rest now, all of you. Even the ones I didn't call.
The sun takes them back. Until tonight.
Quiet again. I can still hear the dead complaining.
My spirits fade with the light. They earned their sleep.
A Dragon Priest. His mask still hums with the old words.
That one has been dead longer than this land has had a name.
Bound to Alduin even in death. I know a stronger binding.
A dragon. Its soul is louder than all the rest.
Alduin calls, and his kin answer. So will mine.
Even a dragon's bones remember how to fly.
Something is wrong with tonight. Even my spirits won't come near it.
The veil is thin tonight. I can feel cold hands on my shoulders.
Strange dead walk tonight. They don't answer when I call.
The curse let go of this place. Its dead can sleep again.
Listen... no screaming under the stones. Just wind.
Go on, all of you. Sovngarde's road is open from here.
So many restless souls in these streets. They're watching me.
This city still belongs to the dead. Not for long.
Every grave here is awake. I can hear them breathing.
The bones remember... and they're showing me the way.
Something old just turned to look at me.
A spirit I've never met. It wants me to follow.
I can feel them, waiting under every footstep.
Even silence has a voice, if I'm patient enough to hear it.
The day is too loud. I miss the quiet of the barrows.
Sleep while you can, little ghosts. Night is coming.
Down together. You'll walk the long road together, too.
So many at once. The spirits will feast tonight.
Rest, all of you. You won't be lonely on the road.
That's how it ends. Quietly, and all at once.
Spirits... closer. I need you closer.
Not yet. I'm not ready to join you yet.
My own soul is slipping. I have to hold on to it.
The cold's in me now. Stay back, all of you.
That one is stronger. Its soul is wrapped in iron.
An old warrior of the mound. Careful, my friends.
A champion of the dead. Let's see whom it truly serves.
My well is dry. Hold them, spirits, just a moment.
No more power to give. I have to wait for it.
Empty. The dead will have to fight for me.
I can see the mist... it's so close.
I'm falling... spirits, don't leave me.
So this is what they feel.
Back. The dead weren't ready for me.
I stood at the edge of the mist. It's colder than I thought.
Breath again. I won't waste it.
The altar's light. Any soul that falls here can pass.
Bring them into the light. I'll walk them home.
The stone is speaking. A riddle... it wants me to find something.
A voice in the altar. Old, and very tired. I'll listen.
Here. This is the place the voice meant.
I found it. Now I hold it, whatever comes.
The stones are singing. I have to remember every note.
Midnight. The altar wants its song sung back.
Wrong stone. The song breaks... I'll wait for the next hour.
The song is answered. The altar heard me.
One seal broken. The priest will feel that.
His binding cracks. I know bindings.
The last seal falls. Come out, priest. I'm waiting.
There you are. Your oath ends tonight.
Sleep, old priest. Alduin can't call you anymore.
His soul is free of the oath. Even he deserved that.
One of his words falls silent. I felt it in every grave.
The dragon is gone, and the dead breathe easier.
The Tongues left this for us. I can feel their hands on it.
Another wonder found. The old masters are with me.
Alduin's echo. Not even a ghost. Just his voice, refusing to die.
Every altar sings. The dead of Skyrim can go home.
Stronger. My spirits will feel that too.
The altar gives, and I'll use it well.
A fallen mage's last spell, given to me. I'll honour it.
A little more strength for the long nights.
That should help. The night is patient, but so am I.
The priest's relic. It still remembers his voice.
It's cold in my hands. Good. Cold things last.
A new spell from the altar. Some mage gave everything for this.
Here they come. Time to light this place up.
Fire, frost or lightning. Pick how you'd like to die.
Night falls. My hands are already burning.
More of you than last night? Good. I was getting bored.
Dawn. And not a single one left standing. Shame.
Ash and morning. My favourite smell.
Another night survived. Barely broke a sweat.
Sun's up. Party's over.
A Dragon Priest. Let's see how that mask handles a firestorm.
Big, old and angry. Burns the same as the rest.
All that power and you still rot. Let me speed it up.
A dragon! Finally, something worth my magicka.
You breathe fire? Cute. Watch this.
Come down here and fight me, you overgrown lizard!
Tonight's different. Good. I was getting bored.
Something's off tonight. Nothing a bigger fireball won't fix.
New kind of dead. Wonder if they burn faster.
City's free. The bards had better say I did most of it.
Curse broken. Somebody owes me a drink. Several.
That's what happens when you let a professional work.
This place reeks of the curse. Time I cleaned it out.
Another city under Alduin's boot. Not for long.
Nice city. Shame about the dead. I'll fix that.
Ha! That did something. I'm doing that again.
Old magic. Strong, too. I like it.
What happens if I set it on fire? Only one way to find out.
Nothing to burn. I hate waiting.
Come on, night. My spells are going stale.
I could be in Winterhold blowing things up. Properly.
I could set that cart on fire. I won't. Probably.
Look at them go. Up in smoke!
One spell, a whole crowd. I'm wasted on this town.
Did you all line up for me? How thoughtful.
Crispy. Every last one.
Ow. Fine. Now I'm angry.
Bleeding. Doesn't matter. Keep casting.
I need a healer. Or a bigger spell. Bigger spell.
That one actually hurt. Lucky shot.
Oh, a big one. Finally, a challenge.
Armoured, is it? Armour melts.
Thinks it's special. Let's test that.
Out of magicka. Of all the times.
Empty. Come on, come on, fill back up.
No sparks left. Time to run like I meant to.
Not like this... not to some walking corpse.
This is embarrassing. Don't tell the College.
Can't... feel my hands. That's the worst part.
Back! I knew I was too stubborn to die.
Death took one look at me and said no thanks.
Right. Where was I? Burning things.
Kill them in the altar's light? Easy. They'll glow either way.
Send them to Sovngarde. I'll provide the fire.
A talking rock with riddles. Of course it is.
Fine, voice. I'll play your guessing game.
Found it. Riddles are easy when you're this clever.
This is the spot. Now let them come.
Singing stones. Fine. Watch, remember, repeat.
Midnight show. Don't blink.
That was the wrong one. Obviously. I was testing it.
Perfect. Was there ever any doubt?
Seal's cracked. Next.
So much for ancient protection.
That's the last seal. Come out, priest!
There he is. Took him long enough.
Mask and all. Ashes.
A Dragon Priest, down. Somebody write that down.
One word down! Who's next?
Killed a word of Alduin's shout. I'm saying that twice.
Now that's what I call a reward.
Old Tongue magic. I can feel it humming. Lovely.
Alduin's echo. A voice with no throat. Let's hear it scream.
Every altar awake. I'd like that in a song, please.
More power. Always more power.
Oh, that's going to hurt them.
Upgraded. As if I needed it.
That'll do. For now.
Every edge counts. Even mine.
The priest's toy. Mine now.
Spoils of war. I've earned them.
A new spell! Let's see what it blows up.
Flasks full, corks loose. Let's begin, my darlings.
The dead rise right on schedule. Shame nothing else in Skyrim does.
Tonight's experiment: how many of them can one flask take?
Fresh samples, walking right to me. How convenient.
Dawn. Note to self: subjects unresponsive. Very unresponsive.
Morning. Time to scrape them off my boots and restock.
Made it. Mostly in one piece. Mostly.
Another night of data. My notes are getting gruesome.
A Dragon Priest. I'd love a sample of whatever keeps him going.
A big one. Good thing I brought the strong stuff.
Preserved for a thousand years. What a remarkable recipe.
A dragon! Its blood alone would pay for a new laboratory.
Scales, bone, heartblood... hold still, you beautiful thing.
Big. Very big. I'll need a much bigger flask.
Something in the air tonight. I'm not breathing that.
Odd night. My flasks are bubbling on their own.
New symptoms tonight. Fascinating. Terrible, but fascinating.
There. The rot's gone out of this place. My work here is done.
City cured. If only every illness were this satisfying.
Clean air again. I'll miss the smell. No, I won't.
I can smell it. The curse is in the water here.
A sick city. Time to find out what the cure looks like.
Ah, the familiar scent of plague and poor decisions.
Interesting. Very interesting.
That reaction shouldn't be possible. I have to try it again.
Write that down. No, wait, I'm the one who writes things down.
I'll just reorganise my flasks again. Third time today.
Nirnroot, deathbell, a pinch of patience... still waiting.
Three parts frost salts, one part spite...
If nothing happens soon, I'm testing something on myself.
One flask, many results. Excellent efficiency.
Ha! Textbook reaction.
That's the stuff. Literally.
They really should have stood further apart.
Ow. I need a potion. I have potions. Where are my potions?
Bleeding. Note to self: stop bleeding.
That wound will need a poultice. Later. Much later.
Not good. Not good at all. Steady hands.
That one's mutated. I want to know how.
Armoured specimen. I'll need something corrosive.
A big, angry sample. Fine. I'll dilute it.
Empty flask. Empty flask! Refill, refill.
Out of reagents. Improvising now.
Nothing left to throw but insults.
I didn't... finish my notes.
Wrong dose. Definitely the wrong dose.
Somebody... label this one a failure.
Back! Fascinating. Terrible, but fascinating.
So that's what dying tastes like. Bitter.
Breathing again. Strongly recommend it.
Souls rising through the light? I'd love to bottle that.
Kill them by the altar. Simple enough. Even I can follow that.
A riddle from a rock. My favourite kind of puzzle.
The altar talks. I'm writing all of this down.
Solved it. Never doubt a good mind.
Here it is. Now, who brought snacks? Oh. The dead did.
Six stones, one order. Like measuring reagents. I can do that.
They're glowing! Pay attention, pay attention.
Wrong stone. Contaminated the whole sequence.
Perfect sequence. Precise as a balance scale.
Seal dissolved. Everything dissolves eventually.
Interesting runes. Pity I had to break them.
Last seal's gone. And there's the priest. Big. Angry.
Here he comes. I'd hoped for a smaller priest.
The priest is down. Now, about that sample...
Old magic, old bones. Neither lasts forever.
A word of Alduin, gone. The whole world feels lighter.
A dead dragon. I'm going to need a lot more flasks.
The Tongues' own work. I could study this for years.
A wonder! I don't know what it does yet. That's the best part.
Alduin's echo. A disease that won't stop talking. Time for the cure.
Every altar awake. Skyrim's fever has broken.
Better formula. Better results.
Stronger. I wonder how strong it can get.
Refined. That's how I like my tools.
A useful little tonic.
Every advantage helps. Especially the ones in bottles.
The priest's relic. I'll study it later. Carefully.
It's still warm. Old magic never cools.
New equipment! Oh, I can do terrible things with this.
They're coming. Blade up. Spell ready.
I hold this line. Nothing gets past me.
Night again. Same as always: steel first, then fire.
Breathe. Count them. Then cut them down.
Dawn. Clean the blade. Count the wounds.
I held. That's all that matters.
Another night survived. They won't remember me. Good.
Rest now. Tonight comes soon enough.
A Dragon Priest. Watch the hands, not the mask.
That one's the real fight. I stay sharp.
Old, powerful, and alone. It still bleeds like the rest.
A dragon. I get under its wings and I don't stop moving.
It bleeds. Then it can die.
I've fought worse. No, I haven't. Doesn't matter.
Something's changed tonight. I keep my eyes open.
Different enemy. Same answer.
Strange night. Back to the walls.
The city's ours again. Its people can sleep tonight.
The curse breaks here. One less to carry.
Done. On to the next.
The curse is thick here. Weapon drawn.
These people need a sword, not a speech.
Too quiet. I know this kind of quiet.
That's a sign. I follow it.
Old magic answers. I keep moving.
I don't trust it. I'll follow it anyway.
Waiting is part of the work.
I rest while I can. The night doesn't wait.
Check the edge. Check the straps. Check them again.
Too much daylight. I'd rather be ready than rested.
Three down. More coming.
That's how you hold a line.
Clean. Next.
They fall together. Good.
I'm hit. Still standing.
Pull back a step. Heal. Then forward again.
Blood in my eyes. I don't need to see to swing.
Not yet. Not here.
Big one. Watch its swing.
Armoured. Find the gap.
A champion. I'll take it head on.
Out of magicka. Steel it is.
Spell's spent. The blade isn't.
No magic left. Doesn't matter.
Down... I'm down.
I held as long as I could.
Not... finished yet.
Up. Back to the line.
Still breathing. Still fighting.
Death can wait its turn.
Fight by the altar. Give them their rest.
Hold the light. Every one that falls here goes home.
A voice in the stone. I'll listen. I won't trust it yet.
A riddle. Think like a scout. Where would they gather?
This is the place. I hold it.
Found it. Now they come to me.
Watch the stones. Remember the order.
Midnight. Eyes on the light.
Wrong one. Reset. Do it right next time.
Done. In order. Like a drill.
Seal's broken. Keep moving.
Guard down, seal gone. Next.
Last seal. Here he comes.
Face me, priest. Your guards are gone.
The priest falls. His oath dies with him.
Done. The altar is free to wake.
One of his words is silent. I keep going until they all are.
The dragon's down. I keep moving.
The Tongues' work. I'll carry it well.
A weapon worth having. Good.
Alduin's echo. The last of him. I end this.
Every altar awake. The oath is kept.
Sharper. Good.
Better steel, better odds.
Test the weight. Good balance.
It'll help. That's enough.
One more edge. I'll use it.
The priest's relic. A trophy, and a warning.
I'll carry it. I've carried worse.
New gear. I'll learn it before nightfall.
